lines.zh: 我比方才更高了，天都快碰到。
lines.en: I am taller than before; the sky nearly brushes me.

lines.zh: 变身之后，每一步都掀风。
lines.en: After the change, every step raises wind.

lines.zh: 我踏过去，山谷被填了半截。
lines.en: I stride across and half the valley fills.

lines.zh: 鳞片变成暗色，泛着星光的边。
lines.en: My scales went dark with star-lit rims.

lines.zh: 我不再慢慢走，我压过来。
lines.en: I no longer stroll; I bear down.
My tail drags along the ridge.

lines.zh: 气从我的关节里漏出来。
lines.en: Ki leaks from my joints.

lines.zh: 我走一步，云就被推开一层。
lines.en: Each step pushes a layer of cloud aside.

lines.zh: 脚下这块大地，显得小了。
lines.en: This land looks small underfoot now.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡太阳，它就暗了。
lines.en: I raise a hand against the sun, and it dims.

lines.zh: 我踩塌一段城墙，没在意。
lines.en: I crush a stretch of wall and don't notice.
I no longer hide my shape.

lines.zh: 我喘着，每口气都是热风。
lines.en: I breathe, and each breath is hot wind.
Starlight moves through my joints.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的爪子，变大了一圈。
lines.en: I look at my claws: a size larger.

lines.zh: 山河在我眼里只是线条。
lines.en: Rivers and mountains are only lines to me.

lines.zh: 我把腰伸直，天边响了一声。
lines.en: I straighten up and the horizon booms.
I wait for the moment of the next blow.
This pain bought this body.
I have nothing left to prove.
The wind parts around my shoulders.
I hear someone shouting far away.
I don't want to shrink back.
Looking at you is like looking at ants.
My aura drives the birds away.
You reach only my ankle now.
I changed. You didn't.
Is that courage of yours still enough?

lines.zh: 我低头，光从眼里落下来。
lines.en: I look down; light falls from my eyes.
Your sword looks like a needle now.
I don't hate you; I simply must win.

lines.zh: 我说的话，你现在听得清吗？
lines.en: Can you hear me clearly now?
Standing far off is wise.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸都能推你一把。
lines.en: Even my breath can push you.
I've remembered that light in your eyes.
Don't crane your neck too long.

lines.zh: 我这一副样子，你也敢看。
lines.en: You dare look at me in this shape.
You look at me like a natural disaster.
One step is all that separates us.
All seven stars' light is on me.
So small a creature, and unafraid.
This body is receding.
I feel it — the pain cuts deeper.
I brace on one knee; the mountain shakes.
My starlight dims a layer.
That was well struck. Truly.
I straighten up, joints cracking.
My ki is growing unstable.
Wounds this heavy are also rare.
I grit my teeth, and there's light on them.
I'm not down yet. Don't celebrate.

lines.zh: 那点吃食，塞不住我一颗牙。
lines.en: That morsel wouldn't fill one tooth.
You hold it up like a mote of dust.
Take it away. I'm not interested.

lines.zh: 你在这样的我面前，还想喂食？
lines.en: You'd offer food to me like this?

lines.zh: 我笑着，气把东西吹跑了。
lines.en: I laugh, and my aura blows it away.
Don't waste it. Store it.

lines.zh: 你现在做什么，都没用了。
lines.en: Nothing you do now will matter.
I'm not hungry. I want an end.
That weighs less than dust.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，连声音都没有。
lines.en: You hit me and there's not even a sound.
I look down; you're still there.
My leg is thicker than a pillar.
I nudge you and you roll far.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的爪子，快挪开。
lines.en: You stepped on my claw. Move.
There's no soft place under this hide.

lines.zh: 碰撞对你我都不算什么。
lines.en: A collision means nothing to either of us.
You got clear in time. Good.

lines.zh: 同类里没有谁愿意变成这样。
lines.en: None of our kind wants to become this.

lines.zh: 我闻到另一头巨龙的气息。
lines.en: I smell another great dragon.
We regard each other across the ridge.

lines.zh: 它退开了，我的样子太吓人。
lines.en: It backs away; my shape frightens it.
I growl; it answers.

lines.zh: 这形态里没有亲近这种东西。
lines.en: This form has no room for closeness.
Our star-lit edges touch.

lines.zh: 我们各自转身，山都在响。
lines.en: We both turn, and the mountain groans.

lines.zh: 下一次见面，或许是敌人。
lines.en: Next time we meet, we may be enemies.
I've remembered its scent.
One claw of mine is a field's worth.
I can't be bothered with what's on the ground.

lines.zh: 珍珠在我指缝里消失了。
lines.en: The pearl vanishes between my fingers.
I pinch it and it crumbles.
Drops are so small now.
I bend, and a slab of ground gives way.
Leave these for the likes of you.
I lift the iron like a pebble.

lines.zh: 我没什么可装的，鳞缝太窄。
lines.en: I've nowhere to put it; my scale gaps are narrow.

lines.zh: 我收回手，什么也没抓着。
lines.en: I pull my hand back holding nothing.
You're still there. I know.
I raise a hand; my shadow covers you first.
I won't hold back this time.

lines.zh: 我锁定你之后，天就变暗。
lines.en: Once I lock on, the sky darkens.
I have your position precisely.

lines.zh: 我抬手，气在掌心成了团。
lines.en: I raise a hand and ki balls in my palm.
Don't look up; the wind will hurt your eyes.
One step brings me before you.

lines.zh: 我抬起巨爪，地上的碎石都在跳。
lines.en: I raise my huge claw; rubble dances on the ground.
I want to see you raise your hand.
I fix on your shadow.
Raising your sword is courteous.
I wait for you to move. Just once.
I prepared this blow a long while.
You're dead center in my shadow.

lines.zh: 我要看看这副身体能做到什么。
lines.en: Let's see what this body can do.

lines.zh: 我每动一下，山就换形状。
lines.en: Every move of mine reshapes the mountain.
You're running. I hear it.

lines.zh: 我压过来，把天遮了一半。
lines.en: I advance and cover half the sky.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经绕过山谷。
lines.en: My tail has already rounded the valley.

lines.zh: 你换位置，我的计算也跟着换。
lines.en: You shift; my calculation shifts.

lines.zh: 这么小的距离，我不用着急。
lines.en: Such a small distance; I needn't rush.

lines.zh: 我的影子罩下来，你连气都稳不住。
lines.en: My shadow falls, and your ki cannot steady itself.
I raise a hand and block the light.
You're at the river. It isn't deep enough.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我正看着你。
lines.en: You look up at me; I'm already looking.
One stride puts me beside you.
You back to the mountain; no road left.

lines.zh: 我的气息压得草贴着地。
lines.en: My presence flattens the grass.
Everywhere you strike is too shallow.
I wait for you to drop your weapon.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的影子吞了。
lines.en: Your shadow is swallowed by mine.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，山谷就换了方向。
lines.en: I turn, and the valley changes orientation.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，你就得换一次躲的地方。
lines.en: Each step I take forces you to find new cover.

lines.zh: 一爪落下，地面裂到河边。
lines.en: One claw and the crack runs to the river.
A ki burst erupts from my palm.

lines.zh: 我从上往下压，云被撞散。
lines.en: I press down and the clouds scatter.
My tail sweeps and the wall shatters.

lines.zh: 你挡了这一下，手该断了。
lines.en: You blocked that. Your arm should be broken.
This fist dents the very wind.
I come from the front, hidden from nothing.

lines.zh: 你把盾举高，我打你的侧。
lines.en: You raise the shield; I hit your flank.
My landing leaves a crater.

lines.zh: 你退到十步外，我才收手。
lines.en: I stop only after you're ten paces back.

lines.zh: 我的气弹一路上把树都推平了。
lines.en: My blast flattens trees along its path.
This strike is full strength.

lines.zh: 你在我的拳风里站不稳。
lines.en: You can't stand in the wind of my fist.

lines.zh: 你身上裂开的声音，很清楚。
lines.en: The crack in you is very clear.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀撞过去，山脊断了。
lines.en: I ram with my shoulder and the ridge breaks.

lines.zh: 这一掌拍下，扬起的土盖了半片天。
lines.en: This palm strike raises dust over half the sky.

lines.zh: 我吞下七颗星的光，长成这副样子。
lines.en: I swallowed seven stars' light and grew into this.

lines.zh: 变身那一刻，天边响了很久。
lines.en: At the change, the horizon rang for a long time.

lines.zh: 我从旧身体里走了出来。
lines.en: I stepped out of my old body.

lines.zh: 胸口裂开一道，光从里面溢。
lines.en: A split opens in my chest, light spilling out.

lines.zh: 这个形态不是我想要的。
lines.en: This form is not what I wanted.

lines.zh: 我先吸气，气把云都吸了过来。
lines.en: I draw breath and pull the clouds in.

lines.zh: 我站稳时，脚下的山矮了一截。
lines.en: When I steady myself, the mountain beneath is shorter.

lines.zh: 七颗星的形状浮在我背后。
lines.en: The shape of seven stars floats behind me.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，世界小了一圈。
lines.en: I open my eyes and the world has shrunk.
I am no longer the one I was.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，回声撞了三次。
lines.en: I call out; the echo rebounds three times.
This body is lent by starlight.

lines.zh: 风从我的鳞缝里穿过去。
lines.en: Wind passes through the gaps in my scales.

lines.zh: 我低头，看见自己的影子变长了。
lines.en: I look down and see my shadow lengthened.

lines.zh: 这么大的我，走了很久才站稳。
lines.en: Being this large, it took a while to settle.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，伸到了云里。
lines.en: I raise a hand and it reaches into the clouds.
This land isn't enough room for me.

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，火星落下来。
lines.en: I cough once and sparks fall.

lines.zh: 火对着我烧，只烫到鳞边。
lines.en: Fire blazes at me and only scorches my scale rims.

lines.zh: 落地那下，整片林子在颤。
lines.en: The landing makes the whole forest tremble.

lines.zh: 水到我胸口，我依旧站得稳。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I stand firm.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的鳞掀起来一片。
lines.en: The blast lifts a plate of my scales.

lines.zh: 针一样的东西插在我背上。
lines.en: Needle-like things stick in my back.

lines.zh: 符文爬上来，灼着我的骨。
lines.en: Runes crawl up and scald my bones.
This form burns too much.
Lightning pours in through the top of my head.

lines.zh: 虚空里我落得比山还慢。
lines.en: In the void I fall slower than a mountain.
